narracao: The automatic barge failed, and men pushed the stone off by hand. Between fifteen and twenty thousand people turned out, according to the Los Angeles Times.

na_tela.texto:
DUMPING THE ROCK.
Automatic Barge Fails to Do Just What Was Expected.
The operation of dumping a load of rock and thereby actually commencing the harbor work was not so successful as it had been hoped that it would be, but the result furnished valuable info…
…and a general estimate of the crowd at noon placed it anywhere between 15,000 and 20,000.
